precise_limits: The 30-second timeout starts at communicate after Popen. Hashing, filesystem operations, Python/preexec/startup and OS-uninterruptible work have no collector-wide hard deadline; Root must retain its separate outer deadline and isolated outer argv/environment/DEVNULL/core0 receipt.

Process-group SIGKILL is attempted for ordinary completion and caught failure. Escaped sessions/groups, SIGKILL/crash of the collector, repeated interruptions or exceptions inside cleanup, and inherited pipe behavior can escape complete collection/receipt guarantees. No actual startup, timeout, cleanup or failure path was exercised.

Initial exclusive mkdir and attempt save precede the main guarded capture body. A failure there, or failed later receipt writes, can leave no complete final status. Exclusive files are flushed/fsync'd individually; directory entries are not fsync'd. File identity checks before/after are not an atomic/adversarial filesystem snapshot.
